log: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.
Enemy warden used spear for 3 damage.
Enemy heavy infantry used sword for 4 damage.
Enemy archer used bow for 3 damage and took 3 in retaliation.
Enemy recruited a heavy infantry. It acts next turn.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: These houses are empty. The people next door are not. We could be neighbors, if they let us stay.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Dain
dialogue.text: My orders say the dead must leave. My patrol is coming to enforce them.

dialogue.speaker: Village elder
dialogue.text: Give us six days to gather the households. Defend your shelter if you must, but let men who turn back go home. There are sick families here who need the herbs in the northern grove.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: Then we hold our ground. We will not hunt your wounded. And we will bring the medicine.

dialogue.speaker: The company
dialogue.text: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.

campaign.outcome: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: The binding broke at midnight. I waited for another order. None came.

dialogue.speaker: A hollow voice
dialogue.text: Then give us one of our own.

dialogue.speaker: Orin
dialogue.text: We leave the quarry. Keep the archers behind the bones. If the mage finds me, there may not be a second midnight.
